product: 星澄 AI 投資管理與自動操盤系統

trading_system.product: 星澄 AI 投資管理與自動操盤系統

market_data.engine: MarketDataEngine (centralized bounded ingestion; no per-symbol processes)
market_data.sources: replaceable adapters; verified-only realtime; simulated/manual for tests
market_data.storage: SQLite runtime cache + PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading market_* (migration 135)

fund_system.engine: MutualFundEngine (trading/fund/) — identity, NAV, distribution, fee, performance, comparison, exposure, transactions, cost basis, recurring, recommendations, strategies
fund_system.nav_policy: published/estimated/confirmed kept distinct; NAV is not a guaranteed execution price
fund_system.live_trading: disabled — advisory and bookkeeping only this phase
fund_system.sources: manual-import + controlled CSV/XLSX/JSON file import; TDCC/provider feeds pending verification
fund_system.research: Qdrant star-financial-research-v1 for prospectus semantic retrieval

ai_intelligence.engine: InvestmentIntelligenceEngine (trading/intelligence/) — advisory only, separated from execution
ai_intelligence.pipeline: market-data → validation → portfolio-context → market/instrument analysis → strategy-evaluation → risk → proposal → recommendation
ai_intelligence.model_router: shared 星澄 runtime lanes (fast/research); lazy governed-channel consult; degraded rule-only when model down; no per-task models
ai_intelligence.safety: AI cannot order/mutate accounts/modify risk/enable LIVE; external text is untrusted input

strategy_backtest.strategy_engine: trading/strategy/ — StrategyRegistry + immutable StrategyVersionService + validation (IS/validation/OOS/walk-forward, OOS consumed-once) + AI research (proposals land as DRAFT only)
strategy_backtest.backtest_engines: BacktestEngine (equity, PIT-gated next-open fills) / FundBacktestEngine (NAV-priced, publish-delay + settlement) / PortfolioBacktestEngine (multi-account, explicit FX transfers)
strategy_backtest.pit: signals only on confirmed bars; fills next bar; adjusted/raw explicit; survivorship flagged until verified membership source
strategy_backtest.costs: TradingCostEngine — scoped fee rules per broker/account/market/direction; unverified rates marked assumed
strategy_backtest.execution_sim: market/limit/partial/no-fill; slippage bps; same-bar stop/target conservative ordering; broker capability profiles (Fubon sub-brokerage ≠ US-native)
strategy_backtest.live_boundary: LIVE_ELIGIBLE = validation passed only; no execution authorization; simulated fills never reach broker/account/position ledgers
strategy_backtest.queue: bounded concurrency + cancel + timeout; results stale-marked when source revisions land
strategy_backtest.storage: JSON journals + PostgreSQL gptbridge_trading (migration 138); mirrors to ai-assistant strategies/backtest_results
